scope: Offline adoption review only. No production changes, camera operations, card writes or publication.

decision.stop_leak_fix: Recommended as an experimental candidate; not approved for a production release until hardware acceptance.
decision.phase_detect: Do not adopt the proposed direct PDAF observer/servo; the fp-specific availability and geometry gates do not supply usable phase data.

stop_fix.firmware_identity_note: Whole-image hashes differ; critical native instruction ranges agree between the local images, and the submitted sup matches an exact rebuild from current local sources.
stop_fix.relationship_to_lossless: Shared native recMgr abnormal-stop cleanup, not a defect unique to the lossless codec. Relevant to residue after overflow/vbuf/mem stops. Does not fix initial throughput/codec stalls, restore dropped frames or recover descriptors dropped before patch installation.
stop_fix.free_count_read: pool = *(uint32_t *)0xC2F1F3D8; free_count = *(uint32_t *)(pool + 0x112C). The fixed word stores a pointer, not the pool itself.
stop_fix.busy_flag_note: Release returns immediately when manager+0x190 != 0; it does not defer/requeue. The constructor initializes this byte to 0. Offline checks do not prove concurrent lifetime safety.

limits: synthetic pool-return and RAW allocator accounting
no DMA, codec, scheduling, storage or concurrent descriptor-reuse validation

phase_detect.help_strings: pdaf caf/sequence/image/invalid are af dbg bit labels, not standalone shell commands.
phase_detect.limits: This establishes the stock fp path is unavailable; it does not establish the physical absence of phase pixels in the sensor die. Nonzero debug values alone would not establish freshness, validity or a calibrated signed optical cue.
phase_detect.focus_9413: Recording-time use is a static-code inference, not a new on-camera verification.

hardware_acceptance_remaining: Fresh baseline with the existing pool and RAW diagnostics; SD stock vs STFX, lossless OFF and ON, normal stop and abnormal overflow stop.
Confirm pool/RAW return to per-session baseline after cleanup; repeat at least ten takes without drift, and verify the next take can start.
Cover native stills cancellation/error paths because the patch changes a shared routine, and test idle boot/power-off restoration and warm boot over a previous card.
Validate two codec lanes, writer promises, actual DMA completion and media/USB behavior on SD before SSD.
Only after bounded hardware acceptance should the change be included in a maintained release builder.
